name: DataTable
summary: Structured facts to compare in rows and columns, such as a component's props or its keys. The first column heads each row. Wider than the page, it scrolls sideways in its own region; the page never does. One enclosure, one hairline between rows, a header row set apart by tone. Not for a list of named values read one by one (a token reference), for term and details pairs (use DescriptionList) or for layout.
a11y: A native `table` with column headers (`th scope="col"`) and row headers (`th scope="row"`), inside a region named by `label`. The region is focusable only so keyboard users can scroll it. Code in a cell may break at any character, so a long type never forces the page sideways. A row's Move handle is a menu button named "Move" and the row's label; a move is announced ("Moved … to position 2 of 5.") and focus stays on the moved row's handle.

keys.action: moves to the table's scroll region, then to each row's Move handle (with `reorderable`)
scroll the table sideways while its region has focus
open a row's Move menu (Move up, Move down, Move to top, Move to bottom)

props.name: label
props.description: Names the table and its scroll region, e.g. "Button props".

props.name: columns
props.description: The columns, the first heading each row. None (a screen still finding out what it shows): nothing is drawn.

props.name: reorderable
props.description: Each row gets a Move handle before its heading cell, as a reorderable List's items do: drag it, or open its menu (Move up, down, to top, to bottom). Rows need a `label`.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: The row ids in their new order, after a drag step or a Move.

props.name: variant
props.description: `enclosed` (default): one outline round the table and a header row set apart by fill, for facts set inside running content. `plain`: no outline, corner or header fill; a hairline under every row and a muted small header, for a screen that is the table (an app's list of pages or records).

props.name: rowHeader
props.description: `strong`: each row's heading (the first column) at `c.data-table.row-head-strong-weight`, for a list whose rows are named by it. Default `normal`.

props.name: loading
props.description: LR65 (opt-in): the table is loading. Its columns and header are drawn as they will be, with this many rows of shimmer lines (core Skeleton) in place of `rows`, so nothing moves when the rows arrive. The table is `aria-busy`; the region around it still says once what is loading.

props.name: key
props.description: Key of this column's value in each row's `cells`.

props.name: header
props.description: Column heading: a short noun, sentence case.

props.name: stacked
props.description: The parts of each cell stack, one under another, with a small gap (a name and its "Required" note).

props.name: width
props.description: How much of the row's width the column takes. `grow`: whatever the other columns leave (a title). `fit`: as narrow as its content, kept on one line (a date, a status, a row's actions). Unset, the table shares the width by content.

props.name: cells
props.description: The row's value in each column, by column key. The first column's value heads the row.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the row in words, for its Move handle and the announcement of a move (with `reorderable`); default its id.

props.name: data
props.description: `data-*` attributes for the row, for tooling such as revision anchors.

props.name: href
props.description: LR102 (opt-in): the row opens this address. Its heading cell becomes the link (named by the heading's words), the whole row shows hover and focus and a press anywhere on it opens the item; controls inside the row (a check box, a button, a menu, the Move handle) stay their own targets and don't open it. Tab reaches the link; Enter opens it.
